title: Unexplored Science Frontier Mapper — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Identifies under-investigated questions by comparing research results, unanswered questions, and available methods. A proposed mapper of the unknown in science: it compares what has been studied, which questions remain unanswered, and which methods are newly available — then identifies the under-investigated frontiers where a modest effort could yield outsized insight. The map updates as research progresses.
capabilities: Compare studied results against open questions
Spot questions answerable with newly available methods
Rank frontiers by expected insight per effort
Update the map as research progresses
Highlight neglected intersections between fields
